entries.Original: No strat available for this region yet.
Cannot start while you are busy (cutscene, NPC event, crafting, trading, zoning, etc.).
entries.Translated: 忙碌时无法开始，例如观看过场动画、与 NPC 交互、制作、交易或切换区域时。

entries.Original: Run without simulated party members or party AI.
entries.Translated: 不模拟队友，也不启用队友 AI。

entries.Original: Stop the current scenario before changing the run mode.
entries.Translated: 请先停止当前场景，再更改运行模式。

entries.Original: Restart the same scenario immediately after a successful run. A death turns this back off.
entries.Translated: 成功完成后立即重新开始同一场景，死亡时关闭此选项。

entries.Original: Scenarios only run in an inn
entries.Translated: 场景只能在旅馆房间内运行

entries.Original: Scenarios can only be started from an inn — return to one to run a scenario.
entries.Translated: 只能在旅馆房间内启动场景，请先返回旅馆房间。
